description: Oscillator for smooth sounds with low harmonic content, modulating itself as it is moved, with two controls that add overtones

params.text: Offsets the V/OCT input one octave up or down
Offsets the V/OCT input three octaves up and down
Distorts the phase of the oscillator, which creates overtones
Attenuates and inverts the MOD1 input before it is added to the MOD1 knob
Increases the number of harmonics in the wave
Attenuates and inverts the MOD2 input before it is added to the MOD2 knob

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the oscillator, 1V per octave
A control voltage added to the MOD1 setting, scaled by the MOD1 attenuverter
A control voltage added to the MOD2 setting, scaled by the MOD2 attenuverter

outputs.text: The audio output of the oscillator
